GraceTechnology.Language: Markdown (skill and agent prompts, rubrics); JavaScript (ES modules) for the scoring and lint CLI; JSON Schema for findings and reports
GraceTechnology.Runtime: Host coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Kilo, and other Agent Skills runtimes); Node.js 22.20 or newer for the CLI, run through npx
GraceTechnology.Framework: Agent Skills layout discovered by the vercel-labs/skills CLI (skills/NAME/SKILL.md); Claude Code plugin manifest as an optional wrapper; no runtime framework and no third-party npm dependencies in the CLI unless justified
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: make validate for skill structure; node:test for the CLI; golden fixtures (findings.json in, score and lint verdict out); reference reports of a known repository at known commits as a recall benchmark
GraceTechnology.Observability: No runtime telemetry. Each run of scored sections writes its artifacts (recon map, findings.json, report, lint result) into the reviewed repository under a dedicated directory, keyed by commit SHA.

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Prefer existing project libraries and established repository patterns.
The CLI must be deterministic and offline: same findings.json gives the same score and lint verdict.
Skills must degrade to sequential execution where the host agent has no subagents.
CI actions stay pinned by commit SHA with a read-only token, as today.
